summary_en: PAATAM estimates handheld probe motion from complementary geometric and intensity features in photoacoustic volumes and reconstructs globally consistent panoramic 3D vascular maps online. The system reports real-time operation, sub-percent relative tracking error in benchmark sequences, and a 42.3-fold field-of-view expansion during a rat gastrectomy demonstration.

summary_en: Using 42 volunteers spanning Fitzpatrick skin types I-VI and vitiligo, this work separates wavelength-dependent melanin spectral colouring from epidermal ultrasound backscatter as sources of photoacoustic bias. It then introduces a practical spectral correction and adapts plane-wave reconstruction to mitigate the resulting quantitative and image-quality artefacts.
